briefdescription.para: Calls the QSPIPSU Flash Polled example.
Demonstrates XQspiPsu 64-bit DMA flash reads from a 32-bit system.

detaileddescription.para: This file contains a design example using the QSPIPSU driver (XQspiPsu) with a serial Flash device greater than or equal to 128Mb. The example writes to flash and reads it back in 64 bit DMA mode. The example runs only on 32 bit systems, so it cannot access 64 bit pointers directly. To verify that the written data is correct, use a 64 bit processor to access the memory.
This example runs with GENFIFO Manual start. It runs in polled mode. This example illustrates single, parallel and stacked modes. Both the flash devices have to be of the same make and size.

The hardware which this example runs on, must have a serial Flash (Micron N25Q or Spansion S25FL) for it to run. To test in single, parallel, or stacked flash configurations, the necessary hardware must be present. QSPI_MODE (also reflected in ConnectionMode in the instance) must be in sync with the hardware flash configuration being tested.
This example has been tested with the Micron Serial Flash (N25Q512) and ISSI Serial Flash parts of IS25WP and IS25LP series flashes in single and parallel modes using A53 and R5 processors.
